conversation.text: Can you describe a recent situation where you felt you received little support from your manager?

Yesterday a customer credit note waited two days because my lead is on calls with Europe all day and my billing dispute messages sit until the next morning. A 15-minute daily slot or a backup person to ask would really help.
How did the delay in handling the credit note affect your ability to meet other tasks?
It backed up my queue since I was stuck waiting for approval before moving on to other disputes.
What specific change would help you get approvals faster in situations like this?
A 15-minute fixed slot each day with my lead or a designated backup person to ask would really help speed up those approvals.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire reports delays in approvals because the lead is unavailable and suggests a short daily slot or backup person. [MANAGER_SUPPORT] "Yesterday a customer credit note waited two days because my lead is on calls with Europe all day and my billing dispute messages sit until the next morning. A 15-minute daily slot or a backup person to ask would really help."
